first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of teal seats arranged in stepped tiers, with gray steps and passageways between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The large-span light-gray canopy above the stands and its repeated trusses.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A collection of pink-purple illuminated components, including angled components among the seating and the rectangular gate frame at the image-lower-left of Object M.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: A broad, apparently nearly flat green field with alternating broad light and dark stripes.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: A long, narrow gray paved passageway extending between the seating and the turf.

entities.name: Object L
entities.identification: A white-and-pink pentagonal hollow field gate on the turf; in the last frame, its thick white frame and two pink feet are discernible.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: A tall, tower-shaped gate at the far sideline, with cyan-blue illuminated uprights and a relatively wide white-and-pink top.

entities.name: Object N
entities.identification: A nearby tall yellow pole structure at the sideline, with two tall uprights, connecting rods, and bent supports; parts have pink-white or pink-purple bright surfaces.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: White points of illumination near the roof, locally spaced bright points, and intense clusters of light, excluding the rectangular display screen.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: A teal opaque wall strip extending along the lower edge of the seating adjacent to the sideline passageway, locally with a light-colored upper edge.
